worldcombat.skill.megadrain.summary: Launch a pod that restrains the target and drains its life on impact.
The bursting pod deals about %1$s special damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
It draws %1$s wave(s) in all, one every %2$s s.
It flies %1$s blocks (also the real range) at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block rooting radius.
%1$s of each wave's damage is restored to the user.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.burst.on: Burst pod: one heavier, wider burst, but only a single wave, less healing and a slower rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.burst.off: Latching pod: several waves that add up to more damage and healing, but each is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.growth.0: From level %1$s the pod power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.growth.1: From level %1$s the pod power rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the waves to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.0: Hurl a pod that latches onto a foe from a distance
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.1: Trade several waves of damage and healing at once
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.2: Sustain against a target that will not let you close in
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.preference.b: On: one heavier, wider burst, but a single wave, less healing and a slower rhythm - good for one interrupt or a finish. Off: the latching pod - several waves with more total damage and healing.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than throwing. Larger opens with a pod from further away.
Below this health ratio the user prefers mega drain as sustain; higher starts leaning on it for healing sooner.
